findings.resolution: Narrow registered purpose/target/field-scoped fact leaves; full protected action checks retained; no same-decision recursion.

findings.concern: R012/R030 recovery predicates and R044 compliance input/rescan need named bilateral ports, rather than substituting similar queries
findings.resolution: Six named semantic ports, including cause-owner query distinct from Hold composer; explicit fenced noncommit and complete-scan proof.

findings.concern: CF-ROOT shared runtime has established mechanisms but no explicit integration stewardship/startup route
findings.resolution: One platform steward/execution capability, Ops projection, terminating bootstrap and contract-versus-implementation dependency classification.

findings.concern: OrganizationFeatureAccess omitted from owner registry and Hiring unresolved-owner language conflicts with existing R005 concern ownership
findings.resolution: Track model/enum responsibility metadata and owner/consumer documents aligned; ATS feature still disabled/unqualified.

findings.concern: Known compatibility mirrors and static migration gap do not embody complete architectural constraints
findings.resolution: Twelve mirror cases and all 177 model owners indexed; no schema or migration modification; posture D retained.

findings.concern: Privacy protocol convergence versus unproven field/action executor coverage
findings.resolution: Protocol graph can converge while destructive/export paths remain gated on complete actual owner inventories/serializers and provider receipts.

findings.concern: Paid screening source branch must not inherit the marketplace seller gate or require its own check completion; coarse decision graph exposed a Trust/Order/Professional loop
findings.resolution: Paid screening is a separate Order source under WA-R003: createChargeableOrder uses the authoritative Trust package quote and actual purchaser/subject relationship, not Professional seller readiness and not completion of the check being purchased. Trust initiates the paid check only after the source-bound Order qualification. evaluateVerificationReadiness reads existing requirement/evidence; it does not synchronously create a purchase or start a new check. Ordinary marketplace seller gates remain on their actual source/action, and acquired Order entitlement is evaluated separately from new-purchase seller eligibility. This terminates the initial paid-screening dependency without a fake seller or a free screening bypass.

rail_review.review: Actor identity, source relationships, permission, commercial eligibility and exact consent are separate decisions. Current source/security generation at protected effect; recovery/core authentication independent of subscription. Privileged actions require explicit grant plus assurance, not admin shortcut. Current owner relationship facts terminate without authorizing their caller recursively.
